answer_1.quote: We present Semantic Signal Separation (S ), a novel contextualized topic modeling technique that conceptualizes topic modeling as the discovery of latent semantic axes in a corpus.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of 10-word topic descriptions in terms of topic diversity and coherence, using the following metrics. Topic diversity(d) measures how different topics are from each other... Topic coherence(C) measures how semantically coherent topics are... aggregate interpretability (√C·d) ... we also computed the relative frequency of stop words in topic descriptions and the proportion of non‑alphabetic characters.
automatic_metrics: non‑alphabetic character frequency in topic descriptions
